description: This file contains unit tests for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor component of the OpenClawChatUI project. It verifies the preprocessing of markdown content, including image extraction, metadata stripping, and handling of special prefixes.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessorTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing various test cases for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.

methods.name: extractsDataURLImages
methods.description: Tests extraction of base64-encoded images embedded in markdown.

methods.name: flattensRemoteMarkdownImagesIntoText
methods.description: Verifies that remote images are flattened into text references.

methods.name: usesFallbackTextForUnlabeledRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Checks fallback text when remote markdown images lack labels.

methods.name: handlesUnicodeBeforeRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Ensures unicode characters preceding images are preserved correctly.

methods.name: stripsInboundUntrustedContextBlocks
methods.description: Confirms untrusted JSON metadata blocks are removed from markdown.

methods.name: stripsSingleConversationInfoBlock
methods.description: Tests removal of a single trusted info block.

methods.name: stripsAllKnownInboundMetadataSentinels
methods.description: Verifies removal of various known untrusted metadata headers.

methods.name: preservesNonMetadataJsonFence
methods.description: Ensures JSON fence blocks not marked as untrusted are preserved.

methods.name: stripsLeadingTimestampPrefix
methods.description: Removes timestamp prefixes from markdown lines.

methods.name: stripsEnvelopeHeadersAndMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes envelope headers and message ID hints from markdown.

methods.name: stripsTrailingUntrustedContextSuffix
methods.description: Removes untrusted context suffixes from the markdown.

methods.name: preservesUntrustedContextHeaderWhenItIsUserContent
methods.description: Ensures untrusted context headers are preserved if they contain user content.
